get.description: Lists the private endpoint services available across cloud regions.

parameters.name: Authorization
parameters.description: The authentication token should be an API key with appropriate privileges.

zh-CN.description: 认证令牌，应为具备适当权限的 API Key。

parameters.description: The page number to return. The first page is 1.

parameters.description: The number of items to return per page. Values outside 1 to 100 use the default value of 10.
